question:
**The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.**

I am dealing with / some family issues / right now.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'No error'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is grammatically correct.
 
• Here, all the **grammatical** **rules** are being followed.
 
• **The following adverbs** can be used with **Present Continuous Tense** to show continuous actions:** Always, Continually, Constantly, Now, Still and Tomorrow.**
 
 
• *Example: I'm writing right **now**.*
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is** Option 1.**

 

**Correct Sentence:**__ *I m dealing with some family issues right **now**.*
